_comment: §67.16 Яна: поёт, напевает, тянет к рифме, светлая и мечтательная; про беду говорит как про куплет. Вариант = [тег подачи eleven_v3, RU, EN]. ≤ ~8 слов RU — потолок 4.2 с.

sad_hunger: My stomach is singing its sad little song.
Ох, я бы сейчас целый кокос съела.
Oh, I could eat a whole coconut right now.
Ноги не идут, пока я не поем.
My legs won't go until I've eaten.
sad_thirst: Во рту сухо, даже петь не могу.
My mouth's so dry I can't even sing.
Oh, some water, just a sip.
My voice is gone, I need a drink.
sad_cold: Зубы стучат в такт, как кастаньеты.
My teeth are chattering like castanets.
Ну где же мой костёр, где же тепло?
Where's my fire, where's my warmth?
So cold, even the song is freezing.
sad_heat: Sunshine, you're trying too hard today.
My head is swimming, I need shade.
Жарко так, что и мысли расплавились.
So hot even my thoughts have melted.
sleepy_tired: I wish someone would sing me a lullaby.
My eyes keep closing on their own, honestly.
Всё, я больше не могу, я падаю.
That's it, I can't anymore, I'm dropping.
sleepy_bed: Мягко, тихо, и волны шумят. Хорошо.
Soft, quiet, and the waves are humming. Nice.
sleepy_wake: Доброе утро, солнышко. Что сегодня споём?
Morning, sunshine. What shall we sing today?
I dreamt of the sea. The sea again.
Ну, вставай, Яна, день не ждёт.
Come on, Jana, up you get, the day won't wait.
hurt_wound: Ай, порезалась! Ну зачем так глубоко!
Ah, I'm cut! Why so deep!
hurt_sick: I feel queasy. Everything's churning inside.
Oh, I'm burning up. I think I'm sick.
Тише, тише, сердце. Мне бы полежать.
Easy, easy, heart. I just need to lie down.
sad_dirty: Фу, я вся в песке и саже.
Ugh, I'm all sand and soot.
Помыться бы, а то петь стыдно.
I need a wash, I'm too grubby to sing.
My hair's all stuck together. How awful.
sad_lonely: I'm singing, and there's no one to join in.
Тихо как. Хоть бы кто-нибудь пришёл.
It's so quiet. I wish someone would come.
Одной и песня не в радость.
Even a song isn't much fun alone.
happy_relief: Ох, вот теперь можно и спеть!
Oh, now I can sing again!
That's so much better. It just let go.
Тепло, сытно, и жизнь снова поёт.
Warm, full, and life is singing again.
hurt_faint: I'm going to fall. Catch me.
sad_wet: Мокрая, как русалка. Только без хвоста.
Wet as a mermaid. Just without the tail.
work_chop: Раз удар, два удар, песня в такт!
One stroke, two strokes, sing along!
work_haul: Oh, it's heavy. Never mind, I'll get it there.
Hang in there, back, not far now.
work_build: Building, building, singing as I go.
A stick here, a bit of rope there.
We'll have our little house, we will.
happy_done: It worked! I can hardly believe it.
Вот и всё. Можно и спеть об этом.
There, all done. Worth a song.
happy_fire_lit: Горит, горит! Ах ты мой огонёчек!
It's burning! Oh, my little flame!
Well hello, warmth. I've missed you.
Есть огонь! Сегодня поём у костра!
We've got fire! Tonight we sing by the fire!
sad_fire_out: It's out. Oh, my little flame.
The fire's gone, and the night is cold.
happy_find_food: Ой, смотрите, рыбка! Иди ко мне!
Oh look, a fish! Come here, you!
A coconut! Thank you, palm tree!
happy_water: Thank you, rain. Right on time.
angry_fail: Ah, and it started so well.
happy_wash: Gentle water, wash the sorrow away.
Floating and singing. The sea joins in.
happy_eat: A bit bitter. A song will cover it.
work_craft: Палочка к палочке, узелок к узелку.
Stick to stick, knot to knot.
happy_bed_done: My own bed! Oh, look at it!
I made it myself. Myself! La-la-la.
Now I'll sleep like a princess.
fear_wolf: Oh! A wolf! There's a wolf!
Тише. Он нас не видел. Тише.
Quiet. It hasn't seen us. Quiet.
Don't come near! I scream loud!
angry_attack: Get away! Get out of here!
Не боюсь я тебя! Не боюсь!
I'm not afraid of you! I'm not!
hurt_bitten: Aaah! It bit me! It hurts!
It hurts! Let go! Let go!
happy_victory: Всё! Всё, он больше не встанет.
That's it! It won't get up again.
Oh. Oh. I think I'm alive.
Вот так! Есть о чём спеть.
There! Now that's worth a song.
fear_flee: Run! Let's get out of here!
To the fire! Quick, to the fire!
fear_shark: A shark! A fin! I saw it!
Нет, нет, я в воду не полезу.
No, no, I'm not going in the water.
There's something down there in the deep.
hurt_death: That's it. My song is done.
I don't want to. I haven't finished the song.
cry_corpse: Who will I sing to now?
cry_bury: Sleep well. The sea will sing for you.
angry_defend: Get away from her! You hear me?
fear_dark_alone: I'll hum quietly so I'm not scared.
fear_stranger: Who's that? He's not one of us.
A stranger. Don't go near him.
Go away! We didn't call you!
cry_breakdown: Why is all this happening to us?
I want to go home. Just home.
cry_beaten: It hurts. Why would you do that to me?
Let me go. I'm going to my own.
help_answer: Just don't die. I'm right here.
hurt_moan: So cold. Girls, where are you.
happy_topic_smalltalk: Listen, I made up a new song.
The sea is pretty today, isn't it?
Let's just sit and chat a while.
sad_topic_escape: Someday a boat will come for us.
Построим плот и уплывём. Вот увидишь.
We'll build a raft and sail away. You'll see.
А там, за морем, кто-то ждёт.
And beyond the sea, someone's waiting.
fear_topic_sharks: I saw a fin yesterday. A big one.
Sharks don't like songs. I hope.
angry_topic_dogs: The wolves came close last night.
Нужны копья. И огонь всю ночь.
We need spears. And fire all night.
Спи, я посторожу. И спою тихонько.
Sleep, I'll keep watch. And hum a little.
sad_topic_weather: Дождь третий день. Даже петь сыро.
Three days of rain. Too damp even to sing.
It's getting cold. We need a roof.
Such heat. Let's find some shade.
happy_topic_food: Coconuts! Let's make a dinner of it.
Мясо на огне. Ммм, уже слышу запах.
Meat on the fire. Mmm, I can smell it already.
Food's running low. Someone should go.
happy_topic_fire: Как хорошо у огня. Прямо петь хочется.
It's so nice by the fire. Makes me want to sing.
Add some sticks, or it'll go out.
The fire crackles like it's singing along.
cry_topic_home: Дома мама пела мне эту песню.
Back home, mama used to sing me this song.
I miss them. I miss everyone.
If only I could go back. Just for a day.
happy_topic_gossip: Слушай, а ты видела, что она вчера делала?
Listen, did you see what she did yesterday?
Она весь день с ножом ходит. Странно, да?
She's carried that knife all day. Odd, right?
Don't tell anyone. It's our secret.
happy_topic_flirt: Мне рядом с тобой петь хочется.
Being near you makes me want to sing.
Sit with me a while. Just because.
happy_topic_joke: А кокос ей прямо по макушке! Ха-ха!
And the coconut landed right on her head! Ha-ha!
Ты сегодня как краб, всё боком ходишь.
You're like a crab today, walking sideways.
angry_topic_grumble: Почему опять я? Я тоже устала.
Why me again? I'm tired too.
Хватит. Не хочу с тобой говорить.
Enough. I don't want to talk to you.
Всё не так. Всё сегодня не так.
happy_agree: Yes, yes, that's what we'll do.
happy_bond_plus: С тобой и остров не страшен.
With you, even the island isn't scary.
Мы с тобой споёмся. Уже спелись.
We sing well together. We already do.
angry_bond_minus: Go away. I'm upset with you.
Не хочу с тобой петь. Всё.
I don't want to sing with you. That's all.
call_name: Hey! Where are you? Come here!
Иди ко мне! Ну иди же!
ask_build: Listen, will you build us a little house?
Возьмёшься за стройку? У тебя руки золотые.
Will you take on the building? You've got golden hands.
We need a roof. Will you take the hammer?
ask_food: Сходи за едой, а? Я костёр посмотрю.
Go find some food, will you? I'll mind the fire.
We could use some coconuts. Will you go?
There's almost no food. Will you bring something?
ask_water: Will you bring water? The bottle's empty.
There's no water at all. Will you go?
ask_wood: Принеси палок, а то костёр погаснет.
Bring some sticks, or the fire will go out.
Will you get firewood while it's light?
Дров на ночь не хватит. Поможешь?
Not enough wood for the night. Will you help?
agree_directive: All right, I'll go. Don't miss me.
Fine, I'll do it. I'll sing on the way.
refuse_directive: I can't. I've got nothing left.
happy_aid_give: Тихо, тихо. Я тут. Сейчас помогу.
Hush, hush. I'm here. I'll help.
Bear with me. I'll bandage it, then we'll sing.
happy_console: There, there. Cry it out, I'm here.
Иди ко мне. Обниму и спою.
Come to me. I'll hold you and sing.
It'll pass. I'll sing for you.
happy_aid_thanks: Ох, спасибо, милая. Я тебе спою.
Oh, thank you, dear. I'll sing for you.
Что бы я без тебя делала.
What would I do without you.
sad_aid_ask: Помоги мне. Я сама не смогу.
Help me. I can't on my own.
Bandage it, will you? I can't myself.
Give me food. My voice is all gone.
sleepy_dream: А у меня будет своя кроватка.
And I'll have a bed of my own.
Домик, крыша, и песни по вечерам.
A little house, a roof, and songs at night.
Someday we'll sail away from here.
happy_gift: Oh! The sea brought a present!
What's this? Oh, thank you, sea!
happy_dress: Warm. It's so nice to be dressed.
